headline: Patriots Land A.J. Brown While John Henry Worries About Sox
morning_brew: The rumors can finally stop because the front office actually pulled the trigger and acquired A.J. Brown in a blockbuster trade. This is a massive win for New England and exactly what Drake Maye needs entering his second season. National writers are grading the deal, and honestly, who cares what they think. We got a legitimate superstar receiver on this roster now, and the offense has a completely different look. This is the kind of aggressive move we have been begging for, and it signals that ownership is ready to compete.

Meanwhile, over at Fenway Park, the Red Sox are getting ready to host Baltimore tonight, but all the talk is about what is happening behind the scenes. Big Papi came out and said owner John Henry is worried about the direction of this ballclub, which is currently sitting at twenty-five and thirty-three. You think he is worried? Try being a fan watching this team in the division basement. It is nice to hear some honesty from a franchise legend, but worry does not fix the bullpen or get us out of last place. We need action, not anxiety, starting with this tough stretch at our own yard.

As we look ahead to the summer, both the Celtics and Bruins are deep in their off-seasons, trying to figure out how to get back to championship contention. With free agency rankings coming out, the front office better be on the phone right now to find some real help. We have seen what happens when these teams stand pat, and nobody wants a repeat of the early exits we just suffered. It is time to make some moves and get this city back to celebrating championships.

news_digest.headline: Red Sox great Ortiz says owner John Henry 'worried' about team
news_digest.dans_take: If the owner is worried, he should start investing in the product on the field.

news_digest.headline: A.J. Brown trade has Patriots buzzing
news_digest.dans_take: This is the most exciting news we have had in Foxborough in years.
